text:
Reading the first photo, the meal looks like a grilled ham and cheese sandwich on whole grain bread, with a glass of water. Water has no calories, so only the sandwich counts.

Estimated serving: two slices of bread (about 140 kcal), ham (about 40 kcal), cheese (about 80 kcal), and butter or oil from grilling (about 50 kcal). That comes to about 310 kcal, which I rounded to 320 kcal.

The second photo shows only crumbs and a little ketchup-like residue left on the plate and tray. I estimated about 10 kcal left over, so the person ate about 310 kcal.

Macronutrients for the amount eaten, using rough per-ingredient figures: protein about 14 g, carbohydrates about 28 g, fat about 16 g.
